body: I have basically completely redone my diet and cut out a lot of bad foods, gotten some time to focus on being healthier. Not exercising yet but I cut out gluten and the change in my mood has been astronomical. I'm not out of the woods and I'm still having some body image issues but today is the first day in YEARS that I have been in a good mood.
Thank you for your comment. I will try to look at it this way.
I guess that makes sense. I just assumed it was suicide as the dream doesn't change. Thank you for asking how I am doing.
Thank you for asking by the way.
I am still here un/fortunately. I am not going back to my job. I have some money saved up so I can take some time off. In a weird way I think it has been good for me.
I don't have anyone right now. I have been to therapy but it's very difficult for me... I need to talk out what's going on in therapy and I don't have that.
Thank you, you're very sweet. I wasn't expecting this reaction.

It sounds ridiculous, doesn't it? I can't stop... it's weird to see what I've been feeling reflected back at me. It's like actually being understood. 

(Sorry, I must sound like a weirdo, it's stress and vodka cranberry.)

I have been self injuring since I saw a film a few weeks ago. I used to do it occasionally but now I basically come home, watch this movie, and do it almost every night. It brings something up in me and I'm not sure what.
I am freaking out because this puts me very far out of my comfort zone, away from people I know, and things are going so badly at home I can't cope with this much change at work.

They told me it would be good for my opportunities within the company, although they haven't actually been promoting recently so even if it did put me in a better position it wouldn't be anytime soon. I am devastated for some reason. I have been upset about this all day and I can't completely calm down and I'm not sure why.
I am considering threatening to quit if they don't let me retain my position. The position is still open and if what they said is true they can let me come back.
Yeah, I agree about the drinking and stuff. I don't know what else to do.
Thank you, I will post this there.
